sex.evidence: Studies were conducted on a total of 92 male Wistar rats

dosing.evidence: 8-OH-DPAT (Sigma-Aldrich... dose: 3 mg/kg intraperitonelly [i.p.], injection volume: 1 ml/kg, concentration: 3 mg/ml; n = 11)
WAY100,635... dose: 0.4 mg/kg i.p., injection volume: 1 ml/kg, concentration: 0.4 mg/ml; n = 12
(±)DOI hydrochloride... concentration: 0.5 mg/ml, dose: 0.5 mg/kg i.p., injection volume: 1 ml/kg; n = 12
ALT... dose: 1 mg/kg i.p., injection volume: 1 ml/kg; n = 15; dimethyl sulfoxide [DMSO] for ALT

group_housing.evidence: Rats were kept as previously described (e.g., [38])

day_night_flipped.evidence: Behavioral studies were conducted between 9:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m.

assays.assay_name: Object and Place Recognition Test (Open Field Novelty Preference)
assays.assay_description: PhenoTyper open field (45×45×56 cm, 19 lx, black plastic floor) with a 5-min sample trial (two identical polyhedrons) followed 30 min after i.p. drug/vehicle injection by a 5-min test trial in which one polyhedron is moved (novel place) and the other is replaced by a cylinder (novel object). Measures: object exploration durations/frequencies, what/where indices, ambulation, sitting, rearing, head-shoulder motility, grooming, overall distance, and boli excreted.

setup_habituation.evidence: the rats were placed into the open field for 10 min per day for two consecutive days

setup_restrain.evidence: rats were placed (freely) into the open field PhenoTyper

food_restriction.evidence: Standard 5-min open field test with no food in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Standard 5-min open field test with no water in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Thirty min later, the test trial was performed

outcomes.summary: 8-OH-DPAT (3 mg/kg) impaired place recognition (reduced where index), decreased rearing and sitting, and increased ambulation and head-shoulder motility. DOI (0.5 mg/kg) reduced rearing duration/frequency and increased head-shoulder motility but did not affect object or place recognition indices. WAY100,635 (0.4 mg/kg) had no significant behavioural effects relative to saline. ALT (1 mg/kg) decreased feces excretion relative to DMSO but did not impair recognition memory.
outcomes.statistics: Where index (duration): F=7.562, p<0.001; 8-OH-DPAT vs SAL p≤0.0001. Rearing duration: F=12.211, p<0.001; 8-OH-DPAT and DOI vs SAL p≤0.0001. Head-shoulder motility duration: F=9.558, p<0.001; 8-OH-DPAT p≤0.0001, DOI p=0.0006 vs SAL. Ambulation duration: F=6.635, p<0.001; 8-OH-DPAT vs SAL p≤0.0001. Boli: F=3.177, p=0.011; ALT vs DMSO p=0.001.
outcomes.evidence: Compared vehicle, administration of 8-OH-DPAT impaired memory for place, decreased rearing behavior, and increased ambulation as well as head-shoulder movements. DOI administration led to a reduction in rearing behavior but an increase in head-shoulder motility relative to vehicle. Feces excretion was diminished after ALT relative to vehicle.

B1_num_measures.evidence: overall activity, ambulation, sitting, rearing, head-shoulder motility, grooming, object exploration (polyhedron, cylinder), what/where indices, boli

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Total durations/frequencies over the 5-min trial; no within-session time binning reported

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions or behavioural sequences reported

B4_ethological.evidence: rearing, grooming, head-shoulder exploratory movements, object investigation scored as distinct natural behaviours

B5_social.evidence: Focal animal tested alone; no social construct

B6_cognitive.evidence: recognition memory for object and place was assessed

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Evaluation was performed with EthoVision XT (position tracking)

B8_multivariate.evidence: one-way ANOVAs were performed for each variable; no PCA/clustering

E2_shelter.evidence: Open field with Plexiglass walls, no refuge

E4_nesting.evidence: no nesting material reported in apparatus

E5_enrichment.evidence: Objects served as test stimuli, not enrichment

E7_social_context.evidence: Focal rat alone in the apparatus during recording

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water placed in arena during 5-min trial

D1_continuity.evidence: 5-min sample trial and 5-min test trial, both recorded

D2_session_duration.evidence: 5-min sample trial and a 5-min test trial

D3_recording_days.evidence: On the following day, they were subjected to an object recognition test composed of a 5-min sample trial and a 5-min test trial (both same day after habituation)

D4_baseline.evidence: Sample trial recorded before drug injection; data used in within-group what/where indices

D5_followup.evidence: test trial was performed 30 min after administration; no recording ≥24 h post-dose

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural paradigm (object/place recognition in the open field with embedded motor/exploratory and emotionality measures); consolidated as one assay.

Dosing: paper Methods explicitly state DOI 0.5 mg/kg i.p. (abstract says 0.1 mg/kg — likely a typo). Listed all four compounds administered (8-OH-DPAT, WAY100,635, DOI, altanserin) since the rubric requests every psychedelic/drug entry.
Habituation: candidates differed on D3 recording days. Habituation days had no behavioural data reported, so only the sample + test trial (same day) constitute recording days → D3 score 0 (1 day).
B1 set to 7+ (3 points) given the very large number of distinct measures (object exploration ×2, indices, ambulation, sitting, rearing, head-shoulder, grooming, overall activity, boli).
Food/water restriction set to 'during' (standard short open field with no food/water in apparatus); confidence medium because paper does not explicitly state.
